Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorDepositWash

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorDepositWash
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CompressorDepositWash extends Object implements Serializable
Plans and simulates online (live) or offline compressor washing to remove deposits with a wash fluid.

Washing is modelled as screening-level dissolution: for each deposit mechanism the wash fluid can dissolve, the mass removed over the wash is 

 removed = min(deposit mass, washFluidRate * solubility * contactEfficiency * duration)

where solubility (kg deposit / kg fluid) comes from WashFluid and contactEfficiency accounts for imperfect contact during online washing (droplet carry-through, short residence time). Deposits the fluid cannot dissolve are left untouched — so water removes salt but leaves elemental sulfur, while xylene removes sulfur and wax but leaves salt. This drives both wash-fluid recommendation and wash-rate / duration planning.

Typical usage


 CompressorDepositWash wash = new CompressorDepositWash();
 WashFluid fluid = CompressorDepositWash.recommend(deposit); // pick the best fluid
 CompressorDepositWash.WashResult r = wash.wash(deposit, fluid, 200.0, 2.0); // 200 kg/hr, 2 h
 // deposit now has less mass -> compressor.run() recovers performance

    • recommend

      public static WashFluid recommend(CompressorDeposit deposit)
      Recommend the wash fluid that can dissolve the largest total deposit mass currently present.
      Parameters:
      deposit - deposit inventory to clean

      the recommended wash fluid, or null if no fluid dissolves any present deposit

    • wash

      public CompressorDepositWash.WashResult wash(CompressorDeposit deposit, WashFluid fluid, double fluidRateKgHr, double durationHours)
      Simulate a wash: dissolve deposit from the inventory with the given fluid, rate and duration. The CompressorDeposit is updated in place, so a subsequent compressor run reflects the recovered performance.
      Parameters:
      deposit - deposit inventory to clean (modified in place)
      fluid - wash fluid
      fluidRateKgHr - wash fluid mass rate in kg/hr
      durationHours - wash duration in hours
      Returns:
      a CompressorDepositWash.WashResult describing what was removed and the performance recovery
